visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a man in his 40s wearing a white shirt over a black lanyard. He is sitting at a stainless steel table, holding chopsticks and a spoon, eating from a metal bowl filled with beef noodles. The background shows yellow menu boards with red text on a wall. (2) The scene cuts to a high-angle handheld shot of the man walking through a narrow urban alleyway with brick walls on one side and green-painted walls on the other. He carries a black leather bag and looks down, then up at the camera. (3) He arrives at the entrance of a shop with glass sliding doors and various flyers posted on them. He raises his wrist to check a black smartwatch. An employee in a blue shirt is visible in the background kitchen area. (4) Inside the shop, the man is now seated at a table, looking down at a physical menu featuring photos of beef noodle dishes. He points at the listed prices. (5) On-screen graphics display Google Map reviews with stars and comments about the restaurant's reputation. (6) A close-up shot of the beef noodle bowl reveals thick white noodles in a clear broth with green scallions and several slices of beef. (7) The man uses chopsticks to lift a piece of meat with skin, bringing it close to the lens to show its texture. (8) He continues eating and speaking to the camera, gesturing with his chopsticks. He then reaches for a stainless steel container and adds a large spoonful of pickled mustard greens into his bowl. (9) The video concludes with the man giving a final review, alternating between slurping the soup and talking, with the busy shop environment and other diners visible in the background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an honest food review of a popular beef noodle shop in Taipei, specifically investigating whether its price increase to 220 TWD is justified. The creator uses a mix of personal taste tests and price comparisons to inform viewers about the value and quality of the dish, while also offering a cultural perspective on international food rankings versus local preferences.
